title: Halloween Baby Shower
description: A baby shower built on Halloween instead of pastel. A printed “boo is almost due” backdrop sits over a dessert table in coral, black, and rose gold, with a naked cake, cauldrons, and pumpkins on black sand. The guest table runs a rust cheesecloth runner between ghost-print plates and folded place cards, and the gift corner carries a spider-web card box and lettered baby blocks in the same palette.
